overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating legal concept interpretations using LLMs, which qualifies as NLG. It uses both automatic metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, consistency scoring) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (GPT-4o for consistency scoring). Human evaluation was conducted by legal experts using a detailed rubric. The extraction was generally accurate with minor duplications that were cleaned up.
